records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:6 — no null check on document.getElementById('discourse-comments'); if the host page omits the div, comments.appendChild throws a TypeError and the embed silently fails
records.rationale: In newly added app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, `comments` is set via `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then used immediately (`comments.appendChild(iframe);`) with no null/undefined guard. If the host page does not include an element with id `discourse-comments`, this will throw a TypeError and prevent the embed from loading.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:14 — contents << "\n<hr>..." mutates the caller's string in place, surprising callers and making the sha1 depend on a side effect
records.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the passed-in String in place (Ruby `<<` mutates). This is verifiable in the diff at app/models/topic_embed.rb and can cause surprising side effects if the caller reuses the same String object (e.g., duplicate "Imported from" footer on subsequent calls, and SHA1 changes because the method altered the input).

records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:32-34 — fallback url = i.id accepts non-HTTP Atom ids (e.g., urn:uuid:...), which TopicEmbed.import silently drops via the ^https? regex with no logging, making feed gaps hard to diagnose
records.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, it sets `url = i.link` then falls back to `url = i.id` when `url.blank? || url !~ /^https?\:\/\//` (lines ~32-34). In TopicEmbed.import, the first line returns unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, so non-HTTP Atom IDs like `urn:uuid:...` will be silently dropped with no logging, causing missed imports that are hard to diagnose.
